note: Generated by scripts/remap-rules.mjs (#645). One key per catalogue entry moved from the 2026-07-16 rules to the 2026-10-09 rules by text identity, or across a reworded paragraph a re-read found to mean the same (`REREAD` in scripts/rules-editions.mjs). `moved`: the 07-16 numbers the move rewrote. `refs`: per number the entry cites after the move, [book, occurrences, hash of the 07-16 paragraph text it meant (`hash` in scripts/rules-editions.mjs: rule numbers replaced, quote characters, dashes and spacing folded)]. test/rule-refs.test.ts re-hashes each number in the 10-09 book and fails on a mismatch that no REREAD row reads from this hash to that text, fails when the entry cites a number fewer times than `occurrences` (a floor: an edit may add citations, and one that drops a citation lowers its count here), and fails on a `moved` number with no row, so a 07-16 number left in a moved entry goes red even where 10-09 reused it for other text. Rerunning the script considers only entries still on 2026-07-16 and keeps these rows; docs/rules-diff/remap-2026-10-09.md keeps each earlier move as the run that made it wrote it.
